brief.headline: Push for faster payment in exchange for a modest price cut on caps, and line up Manjushree or Mold-Tek as a qualified second source.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for a ₹0.05–0.10/pc reduction on 28 mm caps to move toward the ₹0.65–0.80 band.
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc for 28 mm induction-wad PP caps at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: The market asking price for these caps is ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc. The verdict is 'MARKET-FAIR; modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume / looser spec' — so there's room to move down if we commit volume or adjust specs slightly.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 days, in return for a price cut worth roughly half the freed-up cash.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Paying 15 days faster frees up ₹2.39 L of our cash; keeping 30 days holds ₹4.78 L

brief.financialLeverage: Suraj is a private company and publishes no financials, so we can't see their revenue, profit or cash position. Our ₹58.17 L annual spend is material for a packaging converter of this size, but without their numbers we don't know exactly how big a customer we are. The plan leans on our own purchase data, the open-market asking price and lining up a robust second source. Since we can't gauge their financial health, treat them professionally — focus on mutual benefit (faster payment for a better price) and quietly qualify an alternate so we're not dependent.

evidence.point: Our annual spend with them is ₹58.17 L
We currently pay 30 days after receipt, tying up ₹4.78 L of our cash
Paying 15 days faster would free up ₹2.39 L for us
Market asking price for 28 mm PP caps is typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) making pharma bottles, caps and preforms — top second-source candidate, strong and proven.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹1010.97 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) serving pharma with pails, containers and closures — robust alternate for bottles and caps.

alternates.name: Reliance Industries Limited (lead to qualify)
alternates.why: Pan-India manufacturer of packaging materials — a lead to qualify before issuing an RFQ; verify capability and MOQs for pharma caps.

risks: Suraj publishes no financials, so we can't tell if they're healthy or stretched — watch for any signs of delivery delays or quality slips that might signal trouble.
Without their revenue figure, we don't know how much leverage our ₹58.17 L gives us — don't push so hard that a smaller supplier walks away.
The market backups (Reliance, Srichakra, IVL Dhunseri, Dalmia, Ganesha, Chemco) are leads from web research, not qualified sources — verify each before treating them as real alternates.
If we shift to 15-day payment for a price cut, make sure the saving exceeds the cash cost to us (the ₹2.39 L we'd free up can earn or save us money elsewhere).
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to grow our cap volume with you and explore faster payment — let's talk about a price that works for both sides if we commit higher volume and pay you in 15 days instead of 30.
